endToEnd.protocol: Two sequential pairs per cell, alternating A/B order, pinned to logical CPU 2. Same Rust 1.95.0 release toolchain for both binaries. Process CPU includes startup; compileMs excludes module load. No concurrent checks. Too few pairs for an end-to-end speed claim.
endToEnd.head: eeec89e2

conclusion: Retain collision-grid and per-point lookup caching. Engine replay time falls 4.3%, branch/edit time 1.9% versus shipped binary. Six real-compile pairs are too few and too close to no change for a reliable whole-compiler speed claim. No solver, search, scoring, trajectory, contact ordering or charged-work change.
